purpose: A new post-iteration synthetic challenge suite to probe generalisation after v1/v2 debugging. Do not tune parser rules directly to individual v3 cases; log failures for the next iteration.
limitations: Synthetic and manually authored by the project author; not production sampled.
External LLM calls are disabled; this measures the offline rules-first path and workflow behaviour only.
Passing does not establish real-world generalisation, clinical safety, or production readiness.

cases.message: Could you rearrange the nurse visit for next Wednesday?
Can we push my mother's appointment out by three days?
Please switch the home visit to the weekend.
Friday is inconvenient; can we find another slot?
Can the nurse visit us a little later in the day?
We have arranged another service, so please cancel this visit.
No need to send anyone for this appointment.
Yes, the original time is fine.
I'm not asking to cancel, I just need some information.
Don't change anything for now; I'll get back to you.
Can you tell me whether the nurse is on the way?
My father may not be available, I'll update you soon.
Please cancel this slot and move the appointment to next Monday.
Aaj possible nahi hai, Saturday shift kar do.
Can we reschedule for six days from now?
